name: Asana Vidhi (Postures)
summary: The first chapter teaches the lineage of Adinatha, qualifications of a yogi, the ideal matha (hermitage), ethics (yama/niyama), and 15 classical asanas including Svastikasana, Gomukhasana, Virasana, Paschimottanasana, Mayurasana, Dhanurasana, Matsyendrasana, and Padmasana, concluding with mitahara (temperate diet).

name: Pranayama & Shatkarma
summary: The second chapter details the purification of the nadis (nadishodhana), the Shatkarmas (Dhauti, Basti, Neti, Trataka, Nauli, Kapalabhati), and the eight Kumbhakas (Suryabhedana, Ujjayi, Sitkari, Sitali, Bhastrika, Bhramari, Murchha, Plavini).

name: Mudra & Kundalini
summary: The third chapter details the awakening of Kundalini through the 10 great Mudras and Bandhas: Maha Mudra, Maha Bandha, Maha Vedha, Mula Bandha, Uddiyana Bandha, Jalandhara Bandha, Viparita Karani, Vajroli, Amaroli, and Shambhavi Mudra.

name: Samadhi & Nadanusandhana
summary: The fourth chapter describes the supreme state of Samadhi, Unmani Avastha, Raja Yoga realization, the four stages of practice (Arambha, Ghata, Parichaya, Nishpatti), and the inward contemplation of unstruck mystic sound (Nadanusandhana).
